meta.scope: offline static; no module loaded, no radio contacted
meta.method: knob literal -> .rodata hit -> lui/addiu materialisation site -> enclosing prologue -> lw+jalr slots inside that function

gaps: a knob whose literal was not found in .rodata is reported absent, not guessed
the function is attributed from the first lui/addiu match; a knob referenced from several functions is represented by one
reaching a 253A slot means the enclosing function dispatches through the HAL vtable, not that this knob is the argument
